name: Camp Mechuwana
description_short: United Methodist camp on Lower Narrows Pond in Winthrop, Maine, with short overnight camps for kids grouped by grade: first-timer, middle school, senior high, music theatre, creative arts and outpost weeks. It also runs a day camp for ages 5 to 12.
refund_policy_summary: Each camp needs a $50 nonrefundable registration fee; the rest is due three weeks before camp. Fees other than the registration fee are refunded if you notify the registrar at least three weeks before camp starts.
swim_waterfront_notes: Property borders Lower Narrows Pond and Lake Annabessacook, with a boat dock and a swimming area. Swimming and boating are part of every camp week.

sessions.name: Middle School/Senior High Music Theatre (finishing grades 6-12)
Middle School/Senior High Creative Arts (finishing grades 6-12)

sources.note: Mailing address PO Box 277, Winthrop ME 04364; no street address shown
Summer Camps 2026 brochure. Youth overnight camps only; family, adult special needs camps and the day camp left out of sessions.
